courses.title: Executive Leadership for Senior Consultants
courses.description: By the end of Executive Leadership for Senior Consultants, you'll be able to apply executive leadership confidently in Consulting Director work, with a working sense of where change management fits alongside it. The course moves from core executive leadership technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at change management woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying executive leadership to a real Consulting Director scenario
Practicing executive leadership through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to change management
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Client Relationship Management
courses.description: Applying Client Relationship Management is a focused course on client relationship management for people already working toward a Consulting Director role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying client relationship management on your own.

courses.title: A Short Guide to Cross-Functional Collaboration
courses.description: A Short Guide to Cross-Functional Collaboration walks you through the basics of cross-functional collaboration, built for people new to Consulting Director work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of cross-functional collaboration, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
